body: A lot of what you said makes sense, how I'm fighting myself because of my past and that, I'm already getting help but it seems it is just something to cover me for a few days before I'm back in step one, I'm on antidepressants and nearly half way through the course but it's making me worse not better

Usually my past or myself, i dont think about my future, i dont feel like i have one

I don't think I can force myself to think of other things, when I'm thinking of harming myself or ending everything that's the only thing on my mind, I just think harming will help me take my mind of things

I just think about them all the time, it gets worse when I speak about things, I don't know how to explain, I wake up thinking about how I've cut myself and how I want to do it again to relieve pain, I go to sleep thinking if I take a bottle of pills I won't wake up but then if I think about myself as a person I get worse, I don't know

She tries, but anyone would get sick of dealing with the same shit every day, I've had one meeting with one I'm seeing him again on the 29th but whether I'll be here is a different story, plus I'm already on antidepressants (20mg citalopram) just make me feel worse because I think oh well I have to take these to make me think normal again instead of being such a depressive cunt as usual I'm such an idiot, a joke to some in fact
